original_test_intent: Validate correctable PCIe Receive Error detection and reporting on the approved NVIDIA platform path without link loss, reset or device-service disruption, after the missing tool, target and Criteria are authorized.
original_method: Keep injection blocked. Future method must map endpoint and upstream/root port, snapshot PCIe topology/link/AER state, inject exactly one vendor-defined Receive Error at the approved direction/target, correlate fresh endpoint/root-port correctable status and OS/firmware evidence, then verify link, driver, device workload and counters recover without reset.
manual_activity: The NVIDIA/platform PCIe owner defines the Receiver Error stimulus and direction, approves the endpoint/root-port target and recovery path, supervises one injection and confirms device continuity.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA PCIe RAS/AER injector specification, version/checksum and supported platform/firmware/OS
Complete endpoint-to-root-port BDF, slot, link width/speed and device-function topology
Exact Receive Error command, injection direction/location and proof it sets the intended correctable condition
Expected endpoint/root-port AER correctable status, masks, root reporting, count delta and timeout
No reset, no link retrain/loss, driver/service/workload continuity and error-clearing policy
Independent console/OOB recovery, device-specific aborts and restoration
safety_requirements: No injection until the source Procedure and Criteria are completed and reviewed
Isolate production traffic and use a recoverable SUT with console/OOB access
Snapshot topology, link state, AER masks/status/counters, driver and workload health without erasing evidence
One mapped link event once; no automatic retries; abort on link down, unexpected retrain, fatal/non-fatal AER, device loss or host instability
Use owner-approved clear only after evidence capture and prove link/device/service restoration
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only PCIe topology, capabilities, link state, AER baseline, logs and device-health evidence
Validate a future vendor procedure and target/evidence mapping during fresh review
Do not choose a BDF or direction, configure masks, run an injector, clear AER, retrain/reset link, recover, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Replace label-only Procedure and TBD Criteria with a Receive Error-specific contract

No reset, fatal/non-fatal escalation, link loss, unapproved retrain or device/service interruption

review_improvement: Makes this generic PCIe CE title traceable to its Receive Error variant and requires direction-specific AER propagation plus link/device continuity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Receiver Error is link-local and the observing endpoint/root port matters. A fresh correctable bit alone is insufficient unless the physical link, BDF and direction are known and the count is bounded; stale status or another link could falsely satisfy it. The missing command and Criteria therefore prevent execution while still allowing a complete static review.
